command: set -u; echo '=== SERVICE UNITS ==='; systemctl --user list-unit-files --no-pager | grep -Ei 'bridge|frankenstein-local' || true; echo '=== SERVICE STATUS ==='; for u in frankenstein-local-bridge.service clay-local-bridge.service; do echo ---$u; systemctl --user show $u -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p FragmentPath 2>&1 || true; done; echo '=== DAEMON CONFIG REFERENCES ==='; grep -nE 'BRANCH|CONTROL|RESULT|MACHINE|OWNER|HOST|argparse|os\.getenv|REMOTE|repo' /home/andreas/.claude/star/local_bridge_daemon.py | head -220; echo '=== RUNNING DAEMON CMDLINE ==='; pgrep -af 'local_bridge_daemon.py' || true; echo '=== STATE REPO ==='; r=/home/andreas/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo; if [ -d "$r/.git" ]; then git -C "$r" status --short --branch; git -C "$r" branch --show-current; git -C "$r" branch -avv | head -80; fi
